parent_model_comparison.score_semantics: Squared residuals on fixed selected evidence, normalized by fixed marginal detector/direct timing scale; not likelihood, chi-square significance, or posterior.
parent_model_comparison.compatibility_semantics: Three marginal standard deviations with declared calibration, receiver, clock and conservative fitted-parent uncertainty; selection effects are not calibrated.
parent_model_comparison.assignment_semantics: Exclusive candidate-to-predicted-arrival matching within each recording; coincident path predictions share one capacity.
